WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.district_id,
        COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client AS c
    GROUP BY c.district_id
), counts_with_region AS (
    SELECT
        dc.district_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        dc.client_count,
        SUM(dc.client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3) AS region_client_count,
        SUM(dc.client_count) OVER () AS total_client_count
    FROM district_counts AS dc
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = dc.district_id
)
SELECT
    district_id,
    region,
    client_count,
    1.0 * client_count / region_client_count AS fraction_of_region,
    1.0 * client_count / total_client_count AS fraction_of_overall
FROM counts_with_region
ORDER BY fraction_of_overall DESC
LIMIT 10;
